answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 175347 Country: Pakistan Title: Property Division of deceased uncle Question: My uncle passed away last month, he had a wife and 5 daughters. He also had 4 brothers and 1 sister. How should assets of my uncle be divided? Answer ID: 175347 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 383/344/M=4/1441) In the question mentioned above if the parents of your deceased uncle are not alive then the property of your deceased uncle shall be divided into 1080 shares after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of total, his wife shall get 135 shares, while each daughter shall get 144-144 shares and each brother shall get 50-50 shares while the sister shall get 25 shares. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x135 = 135 Daughters: 5x144 = 720 Brothers: 4x050 = 200 Sister: 1x025 = 025 Total: 1080 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
